annotations.title: Search upcoming restaurant and bar openings

description: Search upcoming restaurant/bar openings in a metro (pre-opening signals from liquor license & permit filings). Returns venues with estimated opening window, owner and evidence trail. Without an API key: the public tier (filings older than 30 days, block-level address, no owner contacts), each with a link to its page.
name: search_openings
title: Search upcoming restaurant and bar openings
